disclaimer.title: Not medical advice
disclaimer.body: Targets are estimates based on general formulas. If you have a health condition, are pregnant or have had difficulties with food, please talk to a healthcare professional.

welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.subtitle: Eat cheap and reach your goal, wherever you are.
welcome.sameCountry: Destination must be different from your home country.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.sexHelp: Energy expenditure formulas differ by sex. If you'd rather not say, we use the average of both.
profile.underage: This app is for people aged 18 or over. If you're under 18, please talk to your family or a healthcare professional before changing how you eat.
profile.loseBlocked: With your current BMI ({{bmi}}) we don't recommend a weight-loss goal. You can choose maintain or gain.

targets.title: Your daily targets
targets.subtitle: By day type. You can edit them.

warnings.floorApplied: We applied the minimum safe calorie level.
warnings.loseBlockedLowBmi: Your BMI is low: calculated as “maintain”.
warnings.macrosExceedKcal: Minimum protein and fat already cover the calories; carbs set to 0.

issues.kcalBelowFloor: Calories were below the safe minimum; we set them to the minimum ({{floor}} kcal).
issues.kcalTooHigh: Calories are very high for your profile.
issues.fatLow: Fat is low (under 0.5 g/kg); you need it for hormonal health.
issues.saltAboveMax: Salt is above the recommended 5 g/day limit.
issues.macrosMismatch: Calories from macros don't match the kcal target.

targets.helpResources: If you're trying to eat very little, you don't have to deal with it alone. You can talk to your doctor or an eating-disorder support organisation in your country.

today.title: Today
today.comingSoon: Food logging arrives in the next phase.

settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteConfirm: Are you sure? All your data on this device will be deleted. This can't be undone.
